tool.name: Trapiche
tool.description: classify metagenomic samples by biome from text and taxonomy
tool.command: trapiche - #if str($run_text) == 'false' --no-run-text #else --run-text #end if #if str($run_vectorise) == 'false' --no-run-vectorise #else --run-vectorise #end if #if str($run_taxonomy) == 'false' --no-run-taxonomy #else --run-taxonomy #end if #if str($sample_study_text_heuristic) == 'true' --sample-study-text-heuristic #else --no-sample-study-text-heuristic #end if #if str($disable_minimal_result) == 'true' --disable-minimal-result #end if < '$input_ndjson' > '$output_ndjson'

param.name: input_ndjson
param.label: Trapiche sample records (NDJSON)
param.help: One JSON object per line. The final wrapper must stage and rewrite taxonomy dataset paths once the Galaxy input model is finalized.

param.name: disable_minimal_result
param.label: Return workflow-controlled full results
param.help: By default Trapiche returns its compact result.
